title: Keep failed replay commands out of the success path
test_file_status: planned new file in existing tests/voice lane

evidence.observed: Queue record_result with no active sample and drain using the real executor. It returns 'No current sample'; the row is deleted and the queue announces 'All queued commands have been processed.'.

user_impact: Offline commands can disappear without executing while the operator hears that all work was processed.
implementation_scope: Do not treat every returned response string as proof of success. Conservatively distinguish the existing executor's successful responses from refusal/error/unconfirmed responses in this file. Preserve unresolved commands and report them as needing attention, including after retry exhaustion. Avoid automatic retry of ambiguous writes and do not introduce a multi-file return-type migration.
acceptance: No-current-sample, not-found, explicit error and unconfirmed responses are never marked successful.
Unresolved work remains inspectable in SQLite across reopening and cannot be purged as completed.
No blanket all-processed success announcement with unresolved commands; verified successful commands still complete.
Unknown response strings fail closed; repeated drain cycles do not blindly resubmit uncertain writes.
constraints: Change only the named source file and test file for implementation.
All verification uses synthetic fixtures and mocks; no live SENAITE writes or email.
Do not run jobs sharing a source file as concurrent writers.
